pure-announcement.rationale: It is a sample-repo walkthrough documenting an architectural technique for long-running agents, not a launch, release or funding note.

duplicate.rationale: The nearest concepts concern MCP governance, SIEM visibility and context infrastructure; none cover durable state-machine memory or dormancy gates for multi-day agent workflows.

unfalsifiable.rationale: The pattern is backed by public runnable code with linked source files, tests and golden evaluation sets a reader can execute.

durability.rationale: The core trade-off triad — enum-grounded durable memory over chat-log dumps, event-driven dormancy over polling, delegation over monoliths — is a mechanism-level pattern that outlives the Gemini/ADK specifics it is demonstrated on.

actionability.rationale: A builder of any long-running agent can directly adopt the state-machine-plus-webhook-resume design, and the stateless-vs-durable comparison table tells them exactly what to change and why.

atomicity.rationale: Everything in the note serves one statable idea — architect background agents for idle time with persisted state and event-driven resumption — with the rest being implementation detail of that single pattern.
